message: No detected input validation: The code reads videos and metadata from disk without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local path with no remote fetching, and the only remote call (requests.post in send_cv) is an outbound write, not a data fetch; no checksum or integrity verification is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are loaded directly from metadata.json via LABEL_MAP with no distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tool applied before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset loading and preparation code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples on the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained CNN backbones (resnet18, vgg16, etc.) via torchvision's get_cnn without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a plain SGDLearner with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on video data or request parameters before passing them to the model; inputs are loaded and used directly.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (softmax probabilities) are returned from forward() and used in scoring without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a video-based deepfake detection model (RCNN), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
